}}'''Jaem Dawlish''' is the son of [[Melfane Dawlish]], [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne's]] midwife, in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jaem Dawlish}}

He does some work for his mother and had previously worked in a stable. He wants to be apprenticed to an armorer, though Melfane thinks he may be considered a little old for that.
